top_signals.title: India’s Rupee Gains as RBI Measures Bring in Bumper $136 Billion
top_signals.summary: India’s rupee gained as the central bank garnered $136 billion under its capital-raising measures, far exceeding expectations and further boosting its war chest to defend the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
